summary: Recompute of P-L4-010 by position on the page reproduces the registered numbers exactly (298 labels, 4,902 pairs; ZL3b 0 identical at matching positions against a null of 4.9, lower p = 0.005; IT2a 1 against 3.9; RF1b 1 against 4.3), GC2a shows the same low side, and the deficit survives a 30-degree window (3 against 8.7, lower p = 0.018); the total count of identical cross-page labels is exactly at chance in all four editions, while their separations run 30 to 180 degrees in multiples of 15 with a hole below 22 - so a repeated word does stand elsewhere on the wheel, and the window deficit is that one fact read from one end.
